text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle takes me to a mall to<n>shop for skin
care products on our<n>day off...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't look like they have it here<n>either. But
nothin' else'll do...

Urgh... If I don't get my hands on<n>some, my skin's
gonna be as dry as<n>the desert at high noon...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Well, truth is I've never seen it in<n>Japan before.
Sigh... Guess there's nothing to dobut wait for my family to send mesome.
